body: Confirmed and fixed the Phase 5 lead rather than leaving it as a guess. Read both sub-functions fully -- the real per-bar cost is one level down, in ProcessRegime (called 9x, up to 10,000 bars each) and TestConfigWithWeightsEx (called 3x, ~3000 bars each). Both have a per-bar loop calling CalculateMarketFeatures/ClassifyBarToRegime with zero yield points -- ProcessRegime alone can run up to ~90,000 of these calls back to back with no pause. Added the same Sleep(1)-per-1000 pattern already proven safe everywhere else in the file to all three sites. Compiled clean, purely additive. This directly targets the confirmed 22:54 timeout/abnormal-termination -- not yet proven THIS was the exact cause (need a live run through Phase 5 without a timeout to confirm), but it's the strongest, most specific lead available and now it's actually fixed instead of just flagged. Ledger at pass_85, source at WARRANT#103. Whenever you get the M1 history reloaded and reattach, that run tests everything from tonight at once -- WARRANT#91 through #103, plus whether this timeout fix actually holds.
